entries.title: Psalms 47:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> Oh, clap your hands, all you peoples! Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

entries.title: Psalms 47:2
segments: For the LORD Most High [is] awesome; [He is] a great King over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 47:3
segments: He will subdue the peoples under us, And the nations under our feet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:4
segments: He will choose our inheritance for us, The excellence of Jacob whom He loves. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 47:5
segments: ¶God has gone up with a shout, The LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:6
segments: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!

entries.title: Psalms 47:7
segments: For God [is] the King of all the earth; Sing praises with understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 47:8
segments: God reigns over the nations; God sits on His holy throne.

entries.title: Psalms 47:9
segments: The princes of the people have gathered together, The people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth [belong] to God; He is greatly exalted.
